prompt:
Create a brand-new ORIGINAL production game pixel-art sprite atlas for ASHVEIL: the ASH CROW, a small natural black corvid of a cold ash-covered post-disaster highland. Do not copy or trace existing game art. A credible intelligent crow: one head, a stout pointed black BEAK, two dark eyes, compact breast, layered charcoal feathers with tiny restrained blue-grey edge reflections, short fan/wedge tail, exactly TWO separate feathered WINGS attached to shoulders, exactly TWO skinny scaly legs with taloned feet. No four-legged mammal anatomy, no human arms, no extra wings, no bat membranes, no red string, no messenger tube, no accessories or magic/glow. Detailed crisp pixel clusters and sharp readable silhouettes rather than fuzzy painting or cute cartoon. Muted dark but readable natural lighting.

ATLAS: one square 1024x1024 transparent RGBA PNG, EXACTLY 4 equal rows by 4 equal columns, sixteen whole birds individually separated. Each crow occupies ONLY the central 55-60 percent of its cell, leaving at least 45px completely transparent empty margin from every cell boundary. Keep beak and tail entirely inside its own cell. Same model, body/head size and elevated 3/4 game-view camera throughout. No background, scenery, floor or contact shadows, checkerboard, text, labels, border or grid lines.

DIRECTIONS are strict: ROW1 FRONT facing toward the bottom/viewer (beak foreshortened toward viewer, paired legs under breast); ROW2 LEFT facing left (beak at left and tail at right); ROW3 RIGHT facing right (beak right and tail left); ROW4 BACK facing away toward top (folded wings visible on back, beak hidden, tail nearest viewer). Every sprite in a row keeps that same direction.

This atlas is IDLE ON THE GROUND. Four truly distinct poses across each row: 1 calm upright alert stance with both folded wings and two planted feet; 2 chest inhale with head slightly lowered; 3 small curious head/neck tilt and subtle folded-wing feather settling; 4 exhale, head returns and tail flicks subtly. Body and head silhouette visibly change while the feet stay grounded. Do NOT copy identical sprites four times. Four original idle keyframes per direction. Wings remain folded but visibly form the bird's two wings; no flight, hopping or attack in this atlas.
